_comment: 🔄 This subset's own contribution — the inline labelled equation AST composed alongside the graph and geometry playgrounds (1 of s.mathematical.equation's 15 mutation kinds: change-coefficient; ticket 26/09/02/SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION). The equation reaches the JSON export intact (unlike the graph/geometry scene, which is skipped entirely), so change-coefficient is witnessable there — discharged by the serde-json carrier reader below.

oracles.rationale:
📖️ A READER for the ONE remaining kind that is a fact about this subset's own carrier, and a precise statement of why the other nine are not.

This subset's state splits three ways. `equation` is INLINE in `EquationSnapshot`, so it reaches the JSON export intact and `change-coefficient` is witnessable here. The graph's NODES reach the CSV export as `id,label,x,y`, which is why the sibling csv oracle covers exactly the five node kinds. The graph's EDGES, its `directed` flag, its `algorithm` and the geometry's POINTS reach NO carrier at all: `EquationIntoCsv` is declared `IoFidelity::Lossy` and emits only nodes, and the JSON export carries `notation`/`results`/`computed` as `ArtifactChild` handles whose `local_owner` is `#[serde(skip)]`, so the scene behind them is never serialised.

So `connect-nodes`, `disconnect-nodes`, `change-graph-directed`, `update-graph-algorithm`, `replace-graph`, `insert-point`, `move-point`, `remove-point` and `replace-points` are blocked on EXPORT, not on oracles — the same category as `tiff::change-byte-order`. A reader cannot witness what no carrier records, and registering one against them would be a fiction.

qualification.evidence: Validated BOTH ways: (before,before) -> equal:true; (before,after) -> equal:false. Observability is also enforced at GENERATION time: the engine refuses to write a pair whose carrier projection does not move. The coefficient is compared as a Rational lexeme pair, so a value that round-tripped through f64 would read as a difference rather than as noise.

comparisonPipelines.description: Carrier-level equality over the inline equation tree, read through serde_json. GATING for change-coefficient.

stages.description: An independent JSON implementation accepts both files.
Equality over the equation tree — the operative equality.

comparisonProfiles.description: The INLINE equation tree — labels, node kinds and lexemes — plus the composed-child handles exactly as they serialise. The handles are projected so that a change in which child a snapshot points at is a difference, NOT to witness the scene behind them, which they do not carry.

fixtureManifests.notes: A deterministic snapshot whose inline equation is 3/4·x + 2, with change-coefficient rewriting the labelled rational coefficient to 7/5 as an edit to the JSON CARRIER, read back through serde_json — never through this repository's own mutation engine. The coefficient is a Rational lexeme pair, never an f64, matching EquationNodeKind::Rational's own round-trip-exact representation. Observability is checked before the pair is written.
